subject: spanish
title: Physical Descriptions: Ojos y Pelo
welcome_lead: Apply your Spanish to describe what people look like — eyes, hair and more.
meta_desc: GCSE Spanish application adventure on physical descriptions.
final_note: ¡Estupendo! You can now describe anyone's appearance.

concepts.def: Blue eyes — plural noun + plural adjective.
To wear glasses — useful description verb.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use tener for features you 'have': Tengo los ojos verdes (I have green eyes), Tiene el pelo rubio (He/she has blonde hair). Use ser for what someone is: Soy alto (I am tall), Es morena (She is dark-haired).
Because los ojos is plural, the colour adjective must also be plural: los ojos azules, los ojos verdes, los ojos marrones. Watch out: marrón adds -es to become marrones.
A full description: Mi hermana tiene el pelo largo y rubio y los ojos azules. Es alta y lleva gafas. Use y (and) to link, and remember adjective agreement throughout!

mcqs.q: Which is correct for 'she has green eyes'?

numericals.q: How many eyes does a person typically have (los ojos)?
